shortDescription: Robinhood CEO Tenev Vladimir sold 259,166 company shares on September 21 at an average price of $125.58 per share, according to SEC filings. According to ChainCatcher, the transaction was worth about $32.55 million, and his direct holdings fell to 6,907 shares after the sale.
